## Description

Combine recent stock-price momentum with improving earnings or analyst revisions.

## Where it may fit

Persistent earnings-growth trends and gradual information incorporation.

## Vehicles

Growth, GARP, long-short equity and quantitative stock-selection funds.

## Required data

Price total returns, EPS history, earnings surprises/revisions, analyst estimates and announcement dates.

## Caveats
